frequency_question: How often do US quarterly GDP advance estimates fall below 1.5% annualized given current leading indicator states?
membership_rule: Includes all BEA advance GDP estimates for Q3 published in October of each year from 1985 to 2025. Excludes revised estimates (preliminary or final).
provenance_note: claims 41 cases from only 12 named (3.4x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 41 named annual Q3 release events; complete enumeration for the 1985-2025 period.
known_gaps: Excludes quarters other than Q3, as the question specifically constrains the resolution to the October advance estimate of Q3.
skeleton: Total Q3 advance GDP releases in the 40-year window equals 41. Years with <1.5% annualized growth prints in the advance estimate are identified and counted.
multiplier: 8 hits out of 41 total observed Q3 releases over the 1985-2025 baseline window.
validity_reason: Macroeconomic structure governing advance GDP estimation and business cycle frequencies changes slowly over multi-year horizons.
